name: flopilot
description: FloPilot phone app (iPhone + Android): the Refloat Glow UI wrapped with Capacitor, talking to the board over VESC Express BLE.

scripts.www: node scripts/gen-layout.mjs && node scripts/build-www.mjs && esbuild src/app.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=www/app.js
scripts.test: node scripts/test-protocol.mjs && node scripts/test-pkg.mjs && esbuild scripts/test-config.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.test/config.mjs --log-level=warning && node .test/config.mjs && esbuild scripts/test-lcm.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --alias:@capacitor/core=./scripts/stub-capacitor.mjs --outfile=.test/lcm.mjs --log-level=warning && node .test/lcm.mjs
